dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Former Tenryou Commissioner Kujou Takayuki has presently been relieved from his post. He faces charges of dereliction, corruption, endangering the nation and its people, among others, and is awaiting judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Due to his age and in consideration of his accomplishments, he has been confined to his quarters indefinitely, and will not be released on bail.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: If he commits any treasonous acts during this time, his judgment will be executed with great prejudice and without mercy.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: While the Tenryou Commission discusses matters of reformation, its duties shall be performed by a personal deputy of Her Excellency.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: There will be no adjustment in Doushin and Yoriki ranks. Overall command has been ceded to Madam Kujou Sara.
